prompt: I'm changing the signature of `create_graph_store` in `loomgraph.storage.factory`. List every entity in this codebase that would be affected — direct callers plus their callers (depth 2). Return one qualified entity name per line. Function names only — no source paths, no explanations.

ground_truth.notes:
Depth-1 direct callers (10): the 8 `_async_*` CLI helpers in cli/_workspace, _debt, _indexing + `prepare_workspace_store` (which itself wraps create_graph_store) + `status` (cli/_setup, calls it inside a try block to pull workspace stats).

Depth-2 (15 more, total 25): each of the 8 first-tier `_async_*` is called by one click command of the same name. prepare_workspace_store is called by the 7 `_async_*` query helpers that take a workspace + run a single query (cli/_search + cli/_analysis). status is a click command and has no internal callers.

Verified empirically: `loomgraph graph create_graph_store --direction callers --depth 1` returns 10; expanding each gives the 15 additional. The agent should be able to walk this with up to 11 graph calls (1 + 10) within the 10-turn budget — tight but feasible. Failure to surface even the 10 direct callers within budget is a real-world consumer-side limitation worth measuring.

rationale: Class A1 impact analysis at the storage factory boundary. Bigger expected set (25) than A-1 (15) — tests whether Path B's tool-use scales when the answer set demands many graph calls. Path A's README_AI tree mentions create_graph_store in storage/README_AI but doesn't enumerate the full caller chain. Different code layer than A-1 (storage vs cli) to reduce sampling bias.
